subject: Paperclip Factory native environment

requests.prompt:
Design-reference sheet for an original 2D pixel-art platformer environment: an oppressive PAPERCLIP FACTORY vertical escape shaft. Match the restrained chunky pixel language and cool palette of the references, but replace their geometric factory placeholders with intentional industrial design. Environment ONLY: remove all characters, ghost bride, probes, HUD, interface panels, labels and text from the references. These references establish scale and palette, not pixels to copy.
Three equal panels in ONE horizontal row, same pixel scale and side-on orthographic camera, plain dark background, no captions, no border, no watermark. Hard pixel clusters, no gradients, no smooth painting, no bloom, no isometric view.
LEFT: a gameplay-scale industrial shaft vignette with a quiet dark central lane, thin horizontal metal landing ledges staggered between two sides, green protected top strips and muted brass optional service ledges. Machinery and conduits hug the outer walls. Low down, an ascending mass of metallic PAPERCLIPS has a crisp level top boundary. Individual open hooked double-wire paperclips must read clearly; it is NOT blue water, foam, molten lava or a wall of closed rectangles. No decorative ledges crossing the play lane.
CENTER: an organized small material study showing 16x16 steel bulkheads, muted rails/conduits, quiet wall variants, 12px-thick ledge end caps and centers, heavy structural floor sections and several seamless open-paperclip pile samples. Distinct foreground edges, subtle rear walls, no random single-pixel noise.
RIGHT: six modular static rear-machinery designs arranged evenly in a2x3 grid, each fitting a64x64 sprite: wire spool, paperclip-bending C-frame press, clip-storage hopper, service cabinet, vertical conduit junction, inspection grille. They must form a recognisable wire-to-paperclip production line. Do not add moving blades, laser beams, fake hazards or coin-like pickups.
Palette: near-black0f191b, deep green24423b/426b50, violet shadow2c2330/34354f, steel575c79/858eb0, restrained mint9dded1/d9ffea, muted green8fa86b, brassb9905d/e5c386, pale metalcbb696. Upper-left light and selective dark outlines. Keep most background at least two value steps darker than interactive ledges. No orange hero color, bright pink, red warning effects or white UI graphics. This is a design reference for manually redrawing a16px tile kit and64px props, not final production sprites.
